about: Every number tools/map/compile_track.py builds this map's ground and houses from. Each row is labelled measured, derived, published or assumed; sheet = docs/object-sheets/hunter-track.md.

map_rect_m.label: assumed
map_rect_m.why: design 1: the farmland's rectangle, the file's x, y and z unchanged

tile_resolution.label: assumed
tile_resolution.why: the farmland map tile's grid, 0.977 m

tile_height_m.label: assumed
tile_height_m.why: the farmland's tile height: one sample is 3.7 mm

class_resolution.label: assumed
class_resolution.why: one ground class until portion 3 dresses the ground

foot_kinds.label: derived
foot_kinds.why: sheet: origin at the foot; with foot_frames the 32 distinct upright objects of the spec

foot_frames.label: derived
foot_frames.why: sheet, the 10 gates: the frames standing at ground level

resting_kinds.label: derived
resting_kinds.why: sheet: origin at the bottom face, so an upright one low enough rests on the ground

resting_top_m.label: derived
resting_top_m.why: above the highest base-course block (20.027 m in the file), below the second course

resting_tilt_deg.label: assumed
resting_tilt_deg.why: a block on its side or a leaning tyre does not rest on its origin

start_forward_m.label: derived
start_forward_m.why: the file's spawn stands on a block and a flight starts on the terrain: 1 m along the heading clears the block by 0.79 m, past the props' 0.353 m

correction_radius_m.label: assumed
correction_radius_m.why: the reach of the smooth local correction round each sample

ribbon_step_m.label: assumed
ribbon_step_m.why: the spacing of the ground samples along a ribbon's straight runs

ribbon_clear_m.label: assumed
ribbon_clear_m.why: the ground lies this far under a ribbon's line, inside the band's own 10 mm lift

sample_gap_m.label: assumed
sample_gap_m.why: a later sample this close to an earlier one is dropped, so the fit stays well conditioned

ribbon_end_m.label: derived
ribbon_end_m.why: the kit's DUPLICATE_POINT_M: a point this close to the last is the file's end marker

dips.label: derived
dips.why: sheet, the 11 low objects: circular, a flat floor to the inner radius, a smooth blend to the outer

houses.label: derived
houses.why: sheet, frame and poses; flat_m (ground kept level past the footprint) and bank_m (the blend beyond it) are assumed, the north house's fitted inside the 4.97 m to its neighbour

probes.label: assumed
probes.why: SplitMix64 as the farmland's: 500 over the map and 500 over the layout, where the ground has its shape
